description:
Drain PR #157 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- [major] scope creep: The PR adds a `__filename` import and uses `path.resolve()` for the main module guard check — this is unnecessary complexity beyond the simple `import.meta.url` check pattern established elsewhere in the codebase — Remove the `__filename` import and use `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === process.argv[1]` like other modules
- [major] silent fallback: The `countParams` function uses a simplistic comma-counting approach that fails on nested parentheses, default parameters, and destructuring — this will give incorrect parameter counts for complex function signatures — Replace with a proper token-aware parameter parser or at least handle nested structures correctly
- [major] fragile parsing: The arrow function name extraction uses unreliable backward scanning that fails with complex expressions and doesn't handle common patterns like `const fn = (x) => {` correctly — This will miss many arrow function names or extract incorrect names — Use a more robust forward-scanning approach or accept that arrow functions often won't have reliable names
